option_relations.rationale: The option describes an ascending aortic aneurysm with thrombus formation complicating coronary perfusion, which is a broader clinical picture than just left coronary artery thrombosis.
The option describes a bicuspid aortic valve with ascending aortic aneurysm and valvular thrombosis, which is a broader clinical picture than just left coronary artery thrombosis.
The option describes organized thrombus formation on a native bicuspid aortic valve with ascending aortic aneurysm, which is a broader clinical picture than just left coronary artery thrombosis.
The option describes a bicuspid aortic valve with thrombus-induced coronary ostial obstruction, which is a broader clinical picture than just left coronary artery thrombosis.
